items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:51:1
items.html:
And when AA in turn sorts for the sake of AVI, to correct them the first time, then the coupling of Atik, male and female, must precede it: As was explained above (page 638, the passage beginning “And it is necessary”), the coupling of AA does not suffice to sort the sortings of AVI, because he is only the lower half of the Keter. Rather, he must join and become one degree together with the Nukva of Atik, who is the upper half of the Keter of Nekudim; and then the Keter is in its wholeness as it was at the time of Nekudim, at the time when the Keter clothed as Mochin in AVI, who are the MAN [Mayin Nukvin] that rose, and then he will be able to correct them. See there.
And this is what he says: “The coupling of Atik, male and female, must precede it, and they return to draw new Mochin to AA and Nukva, so that they may sort the sortings of the parts of AVI, etc., and then the parts of AVI are corrected there within AA.” That is, as has been explained, AA joins with Atik into a single Partzuf, and AA acquires new Mochin through this joining of his. Then he has the illumination of the Keter in its wholeness, and he can correct the sortings of AVI, in such a way that the coupling is ascribed to Atik, but the one who sorts for the Mochin of AVI is only AA, for AA is that part of the Keter which was clothed in these AVI at the time of Nekudim as Mochin. And by virtue of this relation he sorts them now as well.
